title: 3784. Minimum Deletion Cost to Make All Characters Equal

examples.explanation: Deleting the characters at indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 results in the string "c", which consists of equal characters, and the total cost is cost[0] + cost[1] + cost[2] + cost[3] + cost[4] = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 1 = 11.
Deleting the characters at indices 1 and 2 results in the string "a", which consists of equal characters, and the total cost is cost[1] + cost[2] = 5 + 8 = 13.
All characters in s are equal, so the deletion cost is 0.
